title: Septic shock with prolonged ventilation, to LTCH; no final diagnosis or condition, med list deferred to MAR, goals and family discussion not done, no list, choice or quality data

rationale.final_diagnosis: There is no discharge or final diagnosis section; MRSA pneumonia and septic shock can only be inferred from the narrative.
rationale.discharge_condition: No statement of condition at discharge; the course gives ventilator settings but no overall clinical or mental status summary under a condition heading.
rationale.discharge_meds: The summary defers the medication list to a separate transfer MAR that was not provided; only changes are listed.
rationale.goals_of_care: The code status line says goals were not addressed and are to be determined.
rationale.dp_discussed: The note says the plan has not yet been discussed with the daughter (healthcare proxy) and the patient could not participate.
rationale.pac_list: No list of available Medicare-participating LTCHs was given to the patient or proxy.
rationale.pac_choice: No freedom-of-choice discussion; the referral was made on the pulmonary team's recommendation without any documented patient or proxy choice.
rationale.pac_quality_data: No quality or resource-use data was shared.
rationale.pending_results: The pending sputum culture is listed with a named owner (ICU team calls the LTCH attending).
rationale.functional_status: Bedbound with total assistance is a functional status, even though it is poor.
rationale.meds_consistent: No nursing discharge instructions were provided, so there is nothing to compare.
